visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed banner on a light colorful gradient background with decorative shapes/imagery; centered layout with an optional uppercase eyebrow, a large headline, an optional subheading paragraph, and a primary CTA button.
contentPattern: One or two cells: a content cell (eyebrow paragraph, heading, subheading, CTA link) and an optional image-only cell providing the decorative background artwork.
usage: Top-of-page hero banner and closing call-to-action banner sharing the same colorful gradient treatment.
